user.description: Enter one RSS feed URL per line. The integration checks each feed, in order, for an episode published today, and the name to save the downloaded file as under /config/www/.

error.no_feeds: Enter at least one feed URL.
error.invalid_filename: Enter a plain file name, with no path (e.g. journal.mp3).
error.invalid_feed: Unable to parse one of the feeds.

download_latest_episode.name: Download latest episode
download_latest_episode.description: Checks the configured RSS feeds and downloads today's episode if one is available.
